levels.name: Recognise
levels.evidence: Learner can identify forms and sources of energy in the chapter context.

levels.name: Explain
levels.evidence: Learner can explain forms and sources of energy and connect it to everyday devices without copying source wording.

levels.name: Apply
levels.evidence: Learner can use energy transformations in a familiar new situation.

levels.name: Transfer
levels.evidence: Learner can solve or explain an unfamiliar situation using several ideas from Energy — How Things Work and justify the response.

levels.name: Create
levels.evidence: Learner can create a new example, question, model, investigation or explanation based on Energy — How Things Work.

progressionRule: Move upward only when the learner demonstrates the current level independently and can explain the reasoning.
